time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*24)
pixel_convention: full-resolution pixels, x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.evidence: phase correlation of a ground strip, frame 0 vs frame 79: shift (-0.08, +0.03) px, response 0.93; stars and terrain unchanged
camera.letterbox: black bar from row 1195 to 1295 (not part of the scene)
camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate from given depth_info plus a known size)

perspective_cues.ground: grey lunar regolith plane seen at a shallow angle, from the ridge line down to row ~1194
perspective_cues.ridge_note: the sky/ground edge is a nearby terrain ridge, not the true horizon. It is gently curved (lowest row ~987 at x~900); the true horizon is above it and was not measured
perspective_cues.astronaut_depth_trend: the astronaut moves left->right and slightly toward the camera: shadow centroid y 1024 (f0) -> 1047 (f79), feet-on-ground y ~1023 (f17) -> ~1055-1063 (f60-79); apparent size grows ~1.2x (sqrt(mask area) ratio f79/f0 = 1.205; bbox height 340-345 px in the first hop vs 400-440 px later, pose-dependent)

objects.name: astronaut
objects.description: the only person/moving object: white spacesuit with a backpack (PLSS) on the left/back side, gold-dark visor, red stripes on legs and arms; faces and moves to the right (+x)
objects.occlusion: never occluded; always fully inside the image
objects.reference_point: cx, cy = mask centroid (proxy for the pelvis/root; the backpack pulls it slightly up and back, so the pelvis is roughly at or a little below/right of it). bbox_cx, y1 = bottom of the feet

objects.name: astronaut_shadow
objects.description: dark cast shadow of the astronaut on the ground, offset left of the feet (light from upper right). Shows where the astronaut is over the ground

objects.name: lunar_ground
objects.description: grey regolith ground plane with faint craters/texture; static

objects.name: black_sky_with_stars
objects.description: black sky with tiny faint stars; static

events.event: video starts with the astronaut in the air, coming down (end of a previous hop)
events.note: feet 77 px above the shadow top; centroid moving down
feet-to-shadow gap 3 px at f15, 1 at f16, 0 at f17-18; frames 15-18 = stance
gap 4 px at f19, 10 at f20, then increases
centroid cy min 695.3 at f35 (695.5 at f36); helmet top y0 min 507 at f35-37; feet-shadow gap max 102 px at f35-37
gap 6 at f57, 1 at f58, <=0 from f59; the leading foot is planted in front of the shadow by f60

events.event: on the ground walking/stepping, slowing down
events.note: centroid x speed falls from ~15 to ~6 px/frame; centroid y rises 834 -> ~817 (f70) then back to ~832
always moving right (+x) with no reversal; x speed (centroid) ~10 px/frame f0-14, ~20-30 px/frame f15-28 (push-off), ~15 px/frame f30-58, decreasing f59-79

files.tracks/astronaut.csv: per frame: frame, time, cx, cy (mask centroid), bbox_cx, bbox_cy, x0, y0, x1, y1, bbox_w, bbox_h, main_axis_len, across_width (PCA extents of the mask), main_axis_deg, area, occluded
files.tracks/astronaut_shadow.csv: per frame: frame, time, cx, cy, x0, y0, x1, y1, area of the cast-shadow core, gap_feet_to_shadow_top_px = shadow y0 - astronaut y1 (<=~3 means feet touching the ground; negative once a foot is planted in front of the shadow)
files.scripts/: bg.py (median background, camera check), track.py (segmentation and tracks), static_and_overlay.py (ridge line, overlay), probe.py (pixel probes/table printer)
